title: Orphaned future-work direction from W2957614298 (2019)
explanation: Future-work item from openalex:W2957614298 (2019) is unaddressed by any later corpus paper through 2022 (3 yrs). 7 later topically-near papers exist and none addresses it (two-stage matcher). Item: "Take both social media and television screen time modes into account when developing preventive measures and advising parents.". CORPUS-RELATIVE CAVEAT: 'orphaned' means unaddressed WITHIN this 99-paper corpus, not the field; the two-stage matcher's precision is limited (P≈0.64) and the corpus is a sample, so this is a weak, corpus-relative signal — not evidence the field ignored it.

caveats.label: Corpus-relative
caveats.detail: 'Orphaned' means unaddressed WITHIN this 99-paper corpus, not the field; the two-stage matcher precision is ~0.64.

caveats.label: Mixed-fidelity
caveats.detail: 2 supporting paper(s) are abstract-only, which yield ~11x fewer own-work limitations than full text.

consumer.headline: Take both social media and television screen time modes into account when developing preventive measures and advising parents.
consumer.kind_short: A question a paper said needed studying, that nothing else in this library followed up on
consumer.kind_long: When researchers finish a paper they usually name the questions they could not get to. We collected those, then checked whether any later paper in this library actually went and did the work. These are the ones where nothing did.
consumer.strength_meaning: There is real evidence behind this, but it rests on a small number of papers — read them before trusting it.
consumer.why: A paper said this needed studying. That was 3 years ago. Since then 7 later papers in this library worked on closely related topics, and none of them took this up.

caveats.label: Only checked within these 100 papers
caveats.text: Nothing in this library followed this up — but this library is 100 papers, not the whole field. Somebody outside it may well have answered this already. Check before you invest.

caveats.label: Based partly on summaries only
caveats.text: For some of these papers we only had the summary, not the full text. Papers we could read in full reveal far more about their own limits, so this may be built on an incomplete picture.
